text:
maya: Quick sync — planning a small toggle sweep tonight at 00:30 UTC to enable the new safe-defaults on response-normalizer.v2 and lower prefetch.kv for heavy tenants. Who can take the flip and own smoke checks?

tom: I can flip, available from 00:20 UTC. Will stay 30m after. @maya can you paste the exact flags to set? :thumbsup:

maya: thanks @tom. Flags: `response-normalizer.v2 = enabled`, `response-normalizer.v2.safe_mode = true`, `prefetch.kv.window = 0.2` (was 1.0). Also turn on `toggle-audit` so we capture who hit the toggle.

ali: I can run smoke tests. Add me to the rollout watchers. I'll focus on latency p95 and a quick correctness sample.

nina: I'll be on-call for rollback if anything spikes. I have the rollback job ready: `./ops/rollback.sh --component=response-normalizer --tag=stable-v1`

jason: FYI the canary bucket is 1% by default. Recommend we start 1% for 10m -> 10% for 10m -> 100% if green. Agree?

maya: yes keep the phased ramp. Plan: 00:30 flip 1% canary, monitor 10m, bump to 10% at 00:40 if no alerts, full at 00:50. If p95 latency increases >15% or error rate >0.5% open rollback.

tom: ack. I will run the flip and post the raw toggle command in the thread when done.

deploy-bot: reminder: maintenance window opens 00:25 UTC. Please tag messages with `#toggle-sweep` for logs.

ali: smoke checklist (quick):
```
- run 20 representative prompts against canary
- check p95 latency vs baseline (look at dashboards/response-normalizer)
- verify 5 stored user vectors still produce same top-3 reranks
- sanity check SLOs in datadog
```

nina: rollback readiness checklist:
- rollback job tested ✔ (ran on staging)
- monitor alerts wired to pager ✔
- contact list up to date ✔
- reasoned safe-defaults config snapshot stored in S3 at s3://redwood/config-snapshots/2026-03-18-00-00.json

tom: flipping now (starting canary 1%). Command: `./togglectl set response-normalizer.v2 canary=1 safe_mode=true`

tom: flip done. Posting tracer id: trace=tr_7f9c. Watching metrics now.

ali: running smoke against trace=tr_7f9c — first 20 prompts done, p95 latency +4% (within threshold), no increase in errors.

nina: infra looks stable. No new 5xx. Pager hooks quiet.

jason: next bump to 10% scheduled in 10m (00:40). @tom you good to push?

tom: good to push at 00:40. I'll bump and post command.

00:40 UTC — tom: bump done to 10%. Command: `./togglectl set response-normalizer.v2 canary=10` trace=tr_7f9d

ali: smoke round 2 complete. p95 +6% (ok), spot-check outputs look consistent. Ran rerank checks too.

nina: still no alerts, rollback job on standby.

maya: if 10% holds for 10m we go full at 00:50. Everyone still aligned?

all: :thumbsup:

00:50 UTC — tom: bump to 100% done. Command: `./togglectl set response-normalizer.v2 canary=100` trace=tr_7f9e

ali: final smoke quick pass done. Latency within SLOs, correctness checks pass. No anomalies in user-facing sampling.

nina: closing standby. Rolling back artifacts removed from temporary queue.

maya: thanks team — leaving `safe_mode=true` for an extra 24h. Leaving audit tags and notes in the runbook. I'll file a short post-deploy note in #eng-platform tomorrow with relevant dashboards and traces. :raised_hands:

tom: thanks — good sweep.

deploy-bot: maintenance window closed. All changes recorded under #toggle-sweep and runbook entry id rbo_20260318_001.
